definition: to step away and keep clear
description: A sunny cobbled street in an old town with pastel houses and a striped awning. A young woman in a white helmet, black leather jacket and red top rides a classic motorbike up the street and lifts it onto its back wheel as she passes the café. The café guests get out of the way: a young woman in a yellow top leans far back in her chair with her arm up, others press against the wall, and a waiter in a black apron flattens himself in the doorway. A worker in an orange vest stands at the far end.

taps.target: the woman in the yellow top
